subject: Ship current Growth tier marketing copy on cometweb.io/pricing as-is

payload.decision_question: Given verified pricing-page claims from upstream Evidence Pack, issue GO/NO-GO/TEST/DEFER on shipping current Growth tier marketing copy on cometweb.io/pricing as-is.
payload.recommended_action: Ship current Growth tier card copy and feature list on /pricing and /pl/pricing without copy changes.
payload.reasoning_summary: Growth copy is price-accurate per locale ($39/mo EN SSR; 159 zł/mc PL SSR), feature-differentiated from Studio, and supported by CURRENT upstream evidence re-verified live. CLAIM-1 PARTIAL reflects ambiguous research wording about simultaneous dual-currency display, not a falsified Growth marketing claim; product policy uses separate PLN/USD price lists via locale/currency selector.

accepted_claims_for_decision.qualifier: Growth price is locale/currency-specific (USD on EN, PLN on PL); not simultaneous dual numerals on one SSR view.

live_spot_check_findings: EN /pricing SSR renders Growth at $39/mo with 300 Comet Credits / mo feature copy.
PL /pl/pricing SSR renders Growth at 159 zł/mc.
Free primary CTA embeds https://app.cometweb.io/register with no register? query params.
No register? URLs found on EN /pricing HTML.

resolved: CLAIM-1 wording ambiguity resolved: simultaneous dual display false; dual-currency availability via locale/selector true and intentional.

legal.basis: Consumer-advertising surface; separate PLN/USD price lists disclosed in billing note; no Growth card copy asserting simultaneous dual-currency numerals.

financial_risk.basis: Displayed Growth prices match verified live SSR; checkout parity not in scope for copy-only decision.

reputation.basis: Growth feature limits and Studio differentiation verified; no duplicate-tier copy risk.

freshness.basis: All material claims CURRENT within policy at decision as_of.

controls: Keep visible billing note that PLN and USD are separate price lists, not live FX conversion.
Do not add Growth copy implying both PLN and USD numerals display simultaneously on a single default SSR view.
Optional follow-up: click-verify USD→PLN currency selector on EN /pricing and Free CTA runtime navigation (upstream gaps, non-blocking for copy ship).

assumption_risks.assumption: Growth card copy does not hidden-claim checkout prices beyond displayed locale price.

payload.double_crux: If live EN /pricing after USD→PLN selector fails to show 159 zł Growth price, reopen copy/UX alignment.
what_changes_decision: Growth price mismatch vs Stripe/app checkout for same locale/currency.
Addition of copy claiming simultaneous PLN+USD Growth numerals on one view.
Studio/Growth feature copy convergence making tiers indistinguishable.

watch_dependencies.trigger: Stripe or app.cometweb.io checkout price differs from displayed Growth locale price
